headline: Iran: Tanker Hits Mine Crossing the Strait of Hormuz via Unauthorized Route
summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guard said another supertanker hit a mine while crossing the Strait of Hormuz via a route not authorized by Tehran. The report was not independently confirmed in the input.
why: Supertankers carry large volumes of crude, so mine strikes in the Strait raise insurance costs and disrupt oil shipments.
why_moved: A reported mine strike on a supertanker in the Strait of Hormuz raises the risk to crude shipments through the waterway.
